integrity: The proof is an exact support-and-coefficient argument for every nondegenerate binomial parameter; no numerical root finding or finite experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is a counterexample to the universal low-degree factorization conjecture, not a classification of all rational roundings.
The unpublished 2018 Liggett manuscript cited by the source was not available for direct full-text inspection and remains a literature risk.
title: A minimal binomial counterexample to low-degree rational-rounding factorization
